title: Return Method Fee and Changes of Return Method
content:
These clauses govern the Returns & Exchanges return method fee — the fee tied to how the return parcel travels — and changes of return method.

## Method fee register

| Return method | Fee in the method fee register (USD) |
|---|---|
| Mail label | 6.95 |
| Carrier drop-off QR code | 4.95 |
| Scheduled pickup | 9.95 |

## Clauses

1. > **Retired clause — no longer in force.** The clause providing that, where the return type withholds the return method fee, the fee of the chosen method in the method fee register is withheld once per return at settlement whatever the number of units, has been superseded by the current basis and is not applied.
2. **Waiver.** The fee is waived where the return type allows the method fee to be waived and the returning customer holds, on the authorization date, a Marlowe Rewards tier with the free return label perk or a Marlowe & Finch Unlimited membership in status trial or active whose plan covers return labels.
3. > **Retired clause — no longer in force.** The clause stating that waivers do not add up and that one is enough has been superseded by the current basis and is not applied.
4. **All units rejected.** The method fee is not withheld when every unit of the return is rejected, since nothing is refunded to withhold it from.
5. **Changing the method.** The return method can be changed only before the first carrier scan, while the return is in status authorized, and the fee of the method used for the parcel is the one withheld.

## Method changes by return status

| Return status | Method change |
|---|---|
| Authorized (no carrier scan yet) | Allowed |
| In transit, received, inspected, settled | Not allowed — the parcel has been scanned |
| Cancelled or expired | Not allowed — the return is not in status authorized |

Example (hypothetical): a customer authorized with a mail label switches to a carrier drop-off QR code before dropping the parcel off; the parcel then travels on the QR code, so the method used for the parcel is the QR code.

superseded_clauses: Where `return_method_fee_applies`, the fee of the chosen return method in the method fee register is withheld once per return at settlement (fee_type method_fee), whatever the number of units.
waivers do not add up, one is enough
